subject: CloudHarbor Founders Allocation — Final Disbursement
body:
Dear Mr. Whitlock,

Following the conclusion of CloudHarbor's strategic restructuring and the consolidation of several early-stage investment accounts, your organization has been identified as an eligible recipient of a founders' allocation under our original customer participation programme.

Our records indicate that your account was established during the initial operating period of CloudHarbor Systems, when a limited number of customers were offered preferential participation terms. These arrangements were subsequently transferred to our corporate administration division. During a recent reconciliation, an allocation of $18,750 was identified against your customer reference.

The allocation is not a promotional credit or a reduction in subscription fees. It represents a cash distribution from the programme's remaining reserve, and eligible recipients may elect to receive the full amount through a bank transfer. The current disbursement window closes on December 12, 2026, after which unclaimed allocations will be returned to the general programme reserve.

To complete the release, our administration team requires confirmation of the original account holder's identity and a one-time processing contribution of $85. This contribution covers the independent verification and remittance costs associated with the distribution. It is not deducted from the allocation, and the full amount remains payable to the recipient once verification is complete.

Please reply to this correspondence confirming your intention to proceed. Our team will then provide the allocation documentation and the applicable remittance instructions. No changes to your existing CloudHarbor subscription are required, and participation will not affect your current service agreement.

We appreciate your patience while these legacy arrangements are finalized.

Regards,
Mara Ellison
Director, Customer Programme Administration
CloudHarbor Systems

subject: Invitation to our winter accounting career workshop
body:
Hi everyone,

We wanted to share an opportunity for students interested in accounting, finance, and professional services. Northbridge Ledger will be hosting a winter career workshop on January 19, 2027, and we'd be happy to see some of you there!

The workshop is intended for undergraduate students who want to learn a little more about what working at a small accounting firm is actually like. We will have a few members of our audit, tax, and advisory teams joining us to talk about their day-to-day work, how they got started in the industry, and what they wish they had known when they were still at university.

We'll also include a short practical session where participants can work through a simplified business accounting scenario in small groups. No previous accounting experience is required, so please don't feel like you need to have taken every relevant course before attending.

**Event details**

Date: January 19, 2027
Time: 4:00 PM–6:00 PM
Location: Northbridge Ledger, Conference Room 2
Registration deadline: January 12, 2027

You can register through our university outreach page:
https://northbridge-ledger.example/university/events

There will be time at the end for questions and informal conversations with our staff. We are particularly interested in hearing what students are curious about, including internship opportunities, professional qualifications, and the differences between working at a smaller firm and a large accounting organization.

We also want to mention that we are currently accepting applications for our summer student internship program. The application process will open on December 1, and interested students can find more information on the careers section of our website. Attending the workshop is not required for applying, and it will not influence application decisions.

If you have questions about the event or need any assistance with registration, you can simply reply to this email. We can also arrange an alternative format for students who require accessibility accommodations.

Please feel free to share the invitation with classmates who may be interested. We would appreciate if you can register early so we have a better idea of how many people will attend and can prepare enough materials for everyone.

Looking forward to meeting some of you!

Best,
Clara Bennett
University Relations
Northbridge Ledger
